newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India rises on local gains, Reliance.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India rises on local gains, Reliance.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts finished firmer on Thursday following local market gains earlier and news of a bonus share issue by Reliance, traders said.
They said the market had picked up again following a rise on Wednesday and an announcement that the petrochemical group Reliance would issue a one-for-one bonus.
Traders said they had expected an issue of about three shares for every five owned.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.84 points higher 89.15, or 0.95 percent, with the premium over the local market at 26.67 percent from 26.08 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 22.94 points to 4,116.56.
Reliance ended the day off highs but still 50 cents firmer at $23.00/$24.00. State Bank of India shares added 42 cents to $25.75/$26.75.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed down 0.10 points, or 0.13 percent, at 75.80 points, a premium of 42.24 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 3.04 points higher at 133.61, representing a discount to the local market of 3.87 percent.
